mapper.insert: INSERT INTO KAKAO_ALIM ( ALIM_NO, USER_NO, ALIM_TY_CD, ALIM_TTL, ALIM_CN, LINK_URL, READ_YN, SND_DTTM, RGTR_ID ) VALUES ( #{alimNo}, #{userNo}, #{alimTyCd}, #{alimTtl}, #{alimCn}, #{linkUrl}, 'N', SYSDATE, #{rgtrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT ALIM_NO AS alimNo, USER_NO AS userNo, ALIM_TY_CD AS alimTyCd, ALIM_TTL AS alimTtl, ALIM_CN AS alimCn, LINK_URL AS linkUrl, READ_YN AS readYn, TO_CHAR(SND_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS sndDttm, RGTR_ID AS rgtrId FROM KAKAO_ALIM WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY SND_DTTM DESC
